description: dacl10k-v3: Benchmark for semantic bridge damage segmentation is a data set deposited in bsxh.nrclgk by its authors Johannes Flotzinger (University of the Bundeswehr Munich). dacl10k (J. Flotzinger, P. J. Rösch and T. Braml, "dacl10k: Benchmark for Semantic Bridge Damage Segmentation," 2024 IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV), doi: 10.1109/WACV57701.2024.00843) is the first large-scale dataset for automated bridge inspections, containing 9,920 polygon-annotated images across 19 classes, grouped into defects and structural components. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. Formats: ZIP. Size stated: 1090777963. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Custom terms specific to this dataset. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
